_comment: Placed feature for the cave-floor azalea spawner. Placement modifiers (intentionally minimal): count(4) gives up to 4 attempts per chunk roll, in_square randomizes X/Z within the central chunk, biome filters out boundary mismatches. We deliberately do NOT use height_range — the underlying SubterraneanGroundFinder ignores the input Y and walks the whole column from world bottom up to the WORLD_SURFACE_WG heightmap, so a randomized Y added nothing functional and previously coincided with an IllegalStateException ('Requested chunk unavailable') from getBlockState during worldgen. Letting Y stay at the section origin (vegetal_decoration's default) keeps placement deterministic relative to the central chunk.
